tagline: One of the world's leading tire manufacturers with global operations and iconic brand recognition
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of Goodyear's size and commercial performance, reflecting the impact of the 2025 strategic divestitures

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Total revenue of the company, impacted by the sale of the OTR business (671M $ impact), lower volumes, and currency fluctuations, partially offset by improved pricing and product mix
kpis.signal: Decline in revenue due to the sale of the OTR business and lower global tire volumes

kpis.name: Goodyear Net Loss
kpis.description: Net loss of the company in 2025, impacted by non-cash goodwill impairment (Americas), full valuation allowance on U.S. deferred tax assets, partially offset by gains on the sales of the OTR business, Dunlop brand, and Polymer Chemicals business
kpis.signal: Significant net loss due to goodwill impairments and full valuation allowance on deferred tax assets

kpis.name: Tire Unit Shipments
kpis.explanation: Number of tire units shipped (replacement + OE)
kpis.description: Total number of tire units shipped, including replacement tires (113.1M units) and OE, down 4.7% compared to 2024, impacted by lower global volumes
kpis.signal: Decline in tire unit shipments due to reduced global replacement and OE tire volumes

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 18.28 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Net Income

kpis.signal: Net income of -1.72 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.signal: Total assets of 18.21 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 7.26 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.8 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: OTR Business Sale Proceeds
kpis.explanation: Sale of OTR business to Yokohama Rubber Company
kpis.description: Sale of the Off-the-Road (OTR) business to The Yokohama Rubber Company for 905M $ in February 2025, including brand license agreements (10 years) and product supply agreements (5 years)
kpis.signal: Major strategic divestiture transaction completed in February 2025

kpis.name: Dunlop Brand Sale Proceeds
kpis.explanation: Sale of Dunlop brand rights to Sumitomo Rubber Industries
kpis.description: Sale of Dunlop brand rights in Europe, North America, and Oceania to Sumitomo Rubber Industries for 526M $ purchase price, plus 105M $ transition fees and 104M $ for existing inventory, completed in May 2025
kpis.signal: Major strategic divestiture transaction completed in May 2025

kpis.name: Polymer Chemicals Business Sale
kpis.explanation: Sale of Polymer Chemicals business to G-3 Chickadee Purchaser
kpis.description: Sale of the Polymer Chemicals business for 650M $ sale price with 580M $ net cash proceeds, including chemical plants in Houston and Beaumont and R&D facility in Akron, completed in October 2025
kpis.signal: Major strategic divestiture transaction completed in October 2025

risks.title: Significant Operating Losses
risks.score_rationale: Net loss of 1,721M $ in 2025 due to non-cash goodwill impairment and full valuation allowance on deferred tax assets. Impact on financial position and ability to generate profits.

risks.title: Increased Competition and Pricing Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Report mentions impact of competition on results, low-priced tire imports, and estimated tariffs of 300M $ in 2026 on finished goods and raw materials.

risks.title: Raw Material Volatility and Conversion Costs
risks.score_rationale: Increase in raw material costs of 443M $ and conversion costs of 402M $ in 2025 due to inflation. Cost pressures expected to continue despite expected 300M $ benefit in 2026.

risks.title: Tax Risks and Uncertainties on Tax Assets
risks.score_rationale: Establishment of a full valuation allowance on net deferred tax assets in the U.S., indicating uncertainty about the ability to utilize carryforward losses and significantly impacting future taxes.

risks.title: Asset Impairments and Loss of Value
risks.score_rationale: Non-cash goodwill impairment in the Americas segment in 2025, indicating deterioration in the value of previously acquired assets.

risks.title: Supply Chain and Logistics Risks
risks.score_rationale: Increase in transportation costs and customs tariffs of 135M $ in 2025. Projected tariffs of 300M $ in 2026 based on current rates subject to fluctuations.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Uncertainties and Limited Volume Visibility
risks.score_rationale: Report indicates limited visibility on global tire volumes for 2026 amid current macroeconomic and regulatory uncertainties.

risks.title: Post-Divestiture Transition Risks
risks.score_rationale: Three major transactions in 2025 (OTR, Dunlop, Polymer Chemicals) with complex transition agreements. Estimated impact of 185M $ on segment operating income in 2026 due to Dunlop and Chemicals sales.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the 10-K text
